description: Complete open select edit submit cancel recover and close by keyboard alone with no timing-specific keystrokes. Movement-path gestures excepted
Show a visible focus indicator in light dark high-contrast zoomed and overlay states and keep the focused element partly unobscured

rule: render loading error empty and success as explicit states
description: Give loading error empty and success each an explicit UI with loading inside 300ms in a reserved slot and errors named in text with cause and recovery and input preserved and empty titled with one action

rule: meet contrast thresholds for text and controls
description: Hold body text to at least 4.5 to 1 and large text and essential visuals to at least 3 to 1. Inactive and decorative exempted
Retain information and function at 320px vertical width without scrolling in two directions. Genuine maps diagrams media games tables excepted
Wrap or adapt essential text where possible with truncation allowed only if the full value stays discoverable through an accessible input-compatible mechanism
Keep content and function intact at 200 percent text scaling and common text-spacing overrides. Short labels and code excepted per active rules

rule: preserve focus order across responsive reorder
description: Keep sequential focus aligned with meaningful visual order at every responsive state. Regions with no meaningful order excepted

rule: reuse existing components and tokens first
description: Survey project components patterns and tokens before adding new UI and let project convention win over heuristics with only evidence backed gaps as exception

rule: limit line length for body copy
description: Wrap body copy to 45 to 75 characters per line with at least 1.5 line height. Captions and table cells may run narrower
Show a visible state change within 100ms for every tap even if work continues in background. Background sync with no user trigger excepted
Keep filters and scroll position when returning from detail and confirm before discarding unsaved edits. Explicit refresh or logout may reset

rule: expose name role state and value
description: Make name and role programmatically determinable and expose settable states with the visible label contained in the accessible name
Where nested surfaces share a visible
column4: the outer radius is the inner radius plus the padding plus any border width. Past 24px of padding
column5: or where the padding is deliberately asymmetric
column6: treat the layers as separate surfaces and keep each one's radius token

description: Trigger on release with a way to abort by moving off target or to undo and reserve press-down activation for genuinely essential cases only

rule: preserve table header relationships in overflow
description: Keep header to data association intact and allow keyboard-reachable scrolling without clipping values. Responsive re-layout may replace the table only if all meaning and function survive
